parsed.scene_description: The image shows the entrance of a store with a large glass door. The door is open and there is a sign above it that reads "Chinese New Year". On the right side of the image, there are shelves stocked with various types of food and drinks. On the left side, there is another shelf with a table and chairs. In the background, through the glass door, we can see a view of a street with palm trees and buildings. The store appears to be well-lit with natural light coming in from the windows.
